p0.descriptionHtml:
The Windsor Button-Tufted Chesterfield Bed has classic Chesterfield button tufting on a full-height headboard and footboard. It is straightforward and well proportioned, with no unnecessary embellishment, and it is handcrafted in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Chesterfield button-tufted headboard and matching footboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Wooden frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £312.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £338.99; King (5FT) £349.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet. Bespoke fabric and colour requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is the Windsor a traditional Chesterfield bed?

Yes. It has classic Chesterfield button tufting on the headboard and footboard, kept plain and well proportioned.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Contact us to confirm options for this design.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

See also: Chesterfield beds.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Wingback Horizontal Kids Bed combines horizontal channels with softly curved wingback sides that frame the headboard, fully upholstered and handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Horizontal channel headboard with curved wingback sides
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Rounded design with no sharp edges
  • Solid, sturdy wood frame
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. One price applies to all three sizes. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid, sturdy wood frame that is fully upholstered with rounded edges. Available in colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What do the wings add?

The wings frame the headboard and add extra cosiness compared with the Horizontal Channel Kids Bed.

What sizes does the Wingback Horizontal Kids Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT).

Does the bed have sharp edges?

No. It is fully upholstered with enclosed side panels and a rounded design, with no sharp edges.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free and usually takes 3-5 working days, as each bed is handmade to order.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.

Browse all kids beds or read our kids upholstered beds guide. Related: Line Wingback Kids Bed.

p2.descriptionHtml:

p3.descriptionHtml:
Architecture you can sleep under. The Archway Cut-Out Bed has a tall padded headboard with arched cut-out openings, letting the wall show through.

Key features

  • Tall headboard with arched cut-outs
  • Architectural silhouette
  • Fully upholstered base to the floor, no exposed legs
  • Velvet or bouclé
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Made in the fabric and colour you choose. Free fabric swatches are available before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size, headboard height or an ottoman storage base? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose.

Delivery

Free delivery to mainland UK addresses by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
